spanish: No es varón El, y mienta, ni hijo de adam, y se arrepienta. ¿Él dijo y no hará, y habló y no la cumplirá?

findings.issue: Unmarked supplied copula. The clause is verbless (negative + noun + noun); a copula that only makes it a sentence must be asterisk-marked.
Common noun אֵל (H410) is left untranslated as El, with mid-sentence title capitalization. A non-name deity noun is Spanish Dios.
Common noun אָדָם (H120) is dumped untranslated as adam. Common nouns stay Spanish.
Question marks add interrogative force. The tokens have no interrogative particle, only the articulated pronoun, perfects, negatives, and imperfects.
findings.spanishSpan: ¿Él dijo y no hará, y habló y no la cumplirá?

findings.issue: Piel and hithpael imperfects are subjunctive, selecting a modal sense the imperfect morphology leaves open.
Conjunction ו is rendered ni, folding the governing negative into the second clause. Meaning holds as smoothing.

notes: The 3fs suffix on יְקִימֶנָּה is kept as la; hiphil cumplirá stays inside H6965.
